text:
Type: wool runner rug
Use: covering a long floor area, hallways and walkways; hallway, living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, traditional, bohemian
Materials: hand-tufted wool, textured loop pile
Colors: multicolor, warm tan, sage green, slate blue, charcoal, cream outlines
Shape: long narrow runner, repeating quatrefoil Moroccan trellis pattern, cream outlines, low pile, light visual weight
Feel: cheerful, soft, welcoming
Goes with: wood floors, navy or white cabinetry, brass accents; eclectic or transitional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Quarterfoil Wool Runner Rug, 2' 3" x 7' 6", Light Multi
product.description: 100% Wool Imported Add transitional flair to your home with this attractive hand tufted pure wool quarterfoil pattered runner. The Moroccan-inspired latice design in light shades of blue, green, grey, and tan will add an elegant flair to your home. 2'3" x 7'6" Hand tufted from pure wool Made in India Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
